# v67: v66 + B156, meowest's build, bag and small-team draft

**Change:** `src/profile.h` (generated by `tools/profiles.py build --base v66 --prefix b156- --only meowest`) and its hooks in `draft.cpp` and `bot.cpp`:
- **Shop:** no Treasure. Marcella and Heart of Ruin buy Jungle → Prospector → Durability; Ryth, Vendetta and Vesper buy Prospector → Durability → Jungle. All then soak into Bruiser with no health shards. v66 bought Treasure → Prospector → Durability → Jungle → Bruiser with 40% health (HoR 65%).
- **Bag:** bank at 36 gems, not 25 (`tribute_gems`, `threat_tribute_gems`).
- **Draft:** 3 bodies Vesper, HoR, Vendetta; 4 bodies Marcella, HoR, Vesper, Ryth. Five-body drafts are the same set as v66's core, in a different order.

**Why:** on engine 3.0.0, the profile bots built from Aynir's and meowest's panel games run an older movement base (v58) but beat v66 63% and 50% (B155 split). So their draft, build and bag outweigh our v59-v66 fixes. Profgate split (180 games each vs v66):

| variant | margin | deaths | gold | captured |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| + Aynir (all three parts) | +32 ± 38 | −1.3 ± 0.5 ** | −605 ** | +25 |
| + meowest (all three parts) = v67 | +65 ± 41 | −1.3 ± 0.5 ** | −386 | +38 |
| meowest draft only | −6 ± 40 | −0.1 | −177 | +6 |
| meowest build only | +9 ± 33 | −1.1 ± 0.4 ** | −365 ** | +1 |
| meowest bag 36 only | −12 ± 15 | −0.1 | −120 | −12 |
| meowest build + bag | +31 ± 33 | −1.6 ± 0.4 ** | −200 | +28 |

The build and bag together carry most of it: fewer deaths and more gems captured, for less gold (no Treasure).

**Gates:** nonreg vs v66 on all 128 maps PASS, 271/512 = 53%; deaths −1.7 ± 0.4, gems captured +28.5 ± 16, submitted gems +14.5 ± 18.

**Next:** a live panel vs v64p3 (same engine). If v67 is neutral there, try build + bag without the draft.

**Live (version 85, live 10:12Z 6 Nov).** Panel v67p1 vs v64p3 (both engine 3.0.0), 84 paired games: wins 41 → 44, gem margin +45 ± 59, deaths −2.1 ± 0.9 (z −2.4), opponents' gold −647 ± 313; panelcmp verdict BETTER. Kept live. Ranked 7-3 by 10:36Z.
